title: agentic-devbox MCP layer (mcp-global.json / mcp-project.json)
description: MCP servers in the standard mcpServers format. agentic-devbox translates them into each agent's native config. Strings may reference ${VAR} or ${VAR:-default}.

type.description: Defaults to "stdio" when command is set and "http" when url is set.

command.description: Executable for a stdio server, e.g. npx or uvx.

url.description: Endpoint of an http or sse server.

agents.description: Only configure this server for these agent ids (claude, copilot, agy, codex, opencode).

tools.description: Allowed tool names (honoured by Copilot and Codex). Omit or ["*"] for all.

disabled.description: In mcp-project.json: remove a server inherited from mcp-global.json. An entry without command or url modifies the global server of the same name instead of replacing it.
